Registry/discovery/coordinator: none stated in the given files for this service; registersWith left empty. Envoy clusters use type STRICT_DNS (envoy.tmpl.yaml:71 etc.), i.e. DNS resolution, not a registry.

Telemetry frequency: not stated. envoy.tmpl.yaml:27 sets only a 0.250s gRPC timeout, which is not an export interval; batching/export period is library default, not in these files. The otel collector's httpcheck/frontendproxy receiver scrapes http://frontendproxy:${ENVOY_PORT} (otelcol-config.yml:15-17, no collection_interval in that block: library default, not in these files). That is the collector polling the proxy, not an export by the proxy.

Edge protocol is HTTP for all edges (Envoy HttpConnectionManager, envoy.tmpl.yaml:13-15 and routes lines 40-55); the callee names are resolved from the cluster address env vars (.env lines 27, 81, 87, 95, 129, 133, 151, 155).
